entries.name: frontend-review
entries.title: Frontend Review
entries.description: Review UI changes for clarity, accessibility, responsive layout, and visual regressions before delivery.
entries.descriptionEn: Review UI changes for clarity, accessibility, responsive layout, and visual regressions before delivery.
entries.descriptionZh: 在交付前检查界面清晰度、无障碍、响应式布局与视觉回归。

entries.name: release-readiness
entries.title: Release Readiness
entries.description: Turn release work into a bounded checklist covering tests, build artifacts, versioning, and handoff evidence.
entries.descriptionEn: Turn release work into a bounded checklist covering tests, build artifacts, versioning, and handoff evidence.

entries.name: repository-onboarding
entries.title: Repository Onboarding
entries.description: Build a concise, evidence-backed mental model of an unfamiliar repository before making changes.
entries.descriptionEn: Build a concise, evidence-backed mental model of an unfamiliar repository before making changes.
entries.descriptionZh: 在修改陌生项目之前，先建立简洁且有代码证据支撑的仓库理解。

entries.name: bug-investigation
entries.title: Bug Investigation
entries.description: Reproduce, isolate, and fix defects with a falsifiable hypothesis and targeted regression evidence.
entries.descriptionEn: Reproduce, isolate, and fix defects with a falsifiable hypothesis and targeted regression evidence.
entries.descriptionZh: 用可证伪假设复现、隔离并修复问题，同时留下针对性的回归证据。
entries.author: AporiaX

entries.name: test-strategy
entries.title: Test Strategy
entries.description: Select high-value tests around changed behavior, boundaries, failure modes, and regressions.
entries.descriptionEn: Select high-value tests around changed behavior, boundaries, failure modes, and regressions.
entries.descriptionZh: 围绕变更行为、边界、失败模式与回归风险选择高价值验证。
entries.author: AporiaX

entries.description: Produce concise, structured documentation whose claims match the implementation and intended audience.

entries.descriptionZh: 面向目标读者制作结构清晰、内容与实现一致并可验证的文档。
entries.author: AporiaX
